description.narrative: HCGF IV has been established to invest primarily in fast-growing, export-oriented, asset-light companies that leverage Ukraine’s competitive cost base to generate global revenues. In addition, the Fund may also seek out select domestic champions with potential to grow from local to regional market leaders. Sectors will include IT, e-commerce, innovative retail, consumer goods and fintech. The funding objective is to support the Fund in reaching its target size of USD 250mln.
